source_caption:
📺 Saved by the Bell (1989–1993)

Saved by the Bell follows a group of teenagers attending Bayside High School in California as they navigate friendships, relationships, school drama, and the challenges of growing up. At the center of the story is Zack Morris, a charming and mischievous student who constantly comes up with clever schemes to escape trouble, impress his classmates, and outsmart his strict principal, Mr. Belding. Alongside his friends Kelly, Slater, Jessie, Screech, and Lisa, Zack experiences hilarious classroom situations, teenage romances, unforgettable adventures, and important life lessons. Combining lighthearted comedy with heartfelt moments, Saved by the Bell celebrates friendship, first love, loyalty, and the unforgettable memories of high school.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Teen • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Sam Bobrick

source_details.synopsis: Saved by the Bell is an American television sitcom developed by Tracey Wigfield that premiered on November 25, 2020, on Peacock. It is a revival to the original television series of the same name created by Sam Bobrick and follows some of the same characters. The entire main cast from the original Saved by the Bell series reprised their roles in the revival, with the exception of Dustin Diamond (who died over 2 months after the series premiere) and Dennis Haskins as Screech and Mr. Belding, respectively.
